from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)

    for mode in ('button', 'menu'):
        page = browser.new_page(viewport={\"width\": 1440, \"height\": 1000})
        page.goto(f'http://127.0.0.1:4001/read-later.html?mode={mode}', wait_until='networkidle')
        octopus = page.locator('[data-id=\"octopus\"]')
        if mode == 'button':
            octopus.locator('.direct-later').click()
        else:
            octopus.locator('.menu-trigger').click()
            octopus.locator('[data-action=\"later\"]').click()
        assert page.locator('#later-count').inner_text() == '1'
        page.locator('#later-nav').click()
        assert page.locator('.queue-card:visible').count() == 1
        assert page.get_by_text('The surprising intelligence of octopuses').is_visible()
        if mode == 'button':
            octopus.locator('.direct-later').click()
        else:
            octopus.locator('.menu-trigger').click()
            octopus.locator('[data-action=\"later\"]').click()
        assert page.get_by_text('You’re all caught up').is_visible()
        page.locator('#back-to-all').click()
        assert page.locator('.queue-card:visible').count() == 3
        assert page.get_by_text('The surprising intelligence of octopuses').is_visible()
        page.screenshot(path=f'prototypes/read-later-{mode}-confirmed.png', full_page=True)
        page.close()

    browser.close()
print('Checks passed: both Read later entry methods support adding, viewing, marking read, and retaining the bookmark.')
